case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70510.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: 7.5 kW motor — 2027 pricing proposal
move.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

The adjustment in doc:20260914-70510-P02 is 6.5%; could you provide a bridge from the current price to the requested increase, separating material effects, conversion costs and productivity offsets?

We value a sustainable agreement with predictable pricing. Could you consider €355.00 per unit, fixed for the twelve-month term, with payment at 60 days net?

What lower-cost material or production variants could you offer without changing the motor specification, and what savings would each deliver?

Please review the attached package and indicate where you can accommodate it.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. 

We have carefully reviewed your proposal; however, extending the payment terms to 60 days net would necessitate a higher unit price to offset financing costs, thus we propose maintaining 30 days net. 

Our current offer is a price of €372.65 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. As an alternative, we can offer a revised price of €370.60 per unit under the current 30-day payment terms, while our technical department will address your inquiry regarding potential production variants. This alternative package is a price of €370.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel, which is at our standard terms. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: 7.5 kW motor — revised fixed-price packages
move.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for reviewing our proposal. We respect the confidentiality of your calculation; could you instead indicate the aggregate productivity savings already included?

The requested price in doc:20260914-70510-P02 is €370.96 per unit; we would welcome a smaller adjustment supported by production efficiencies.

We can move to €358.00 with 30-day payment, or €360.00 with 60-day payment, both without indexation. The first package retains your standard payment timing.

Could your technical team quantify any savings achievable without changing the motor specification?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We have already taken that notice period data into account. 

Our current proposal stands at a price of €372.46 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

We have reviewed your revised proposal and can adjust our offer to €370.41 per unit under our standard 30-day payment terms, which represents an alternative at a price of €370.41 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel at our standard terms.

Please note that our calculation remains internal; we do not disclose aggregate productivity savings or cost breakdowns. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. 

Our Application Engineering department confirms that we build strictly to your specification; any cost reductions would necessitate a formal specification change. 

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Thank you for the revised offer. The standard payment period in sup:70510 is 30 days; our first package retains that timing to avoid additional financing costs.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for confirming the technical position. We will retain the existing specification and respect the confidentiality of your calculation.

We can increase our proposal to €364.00 with 30-day payment or €366.00 with 60-day payment. Alternatively, we propose €368.00 with 90-day payment. Each package keeps the price fixed without indexation for the twelve-month term.

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your increased proposal and have adjusted our offer for the 30-day payment package in response. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our offer stands at a price of €370.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.

The premium for extended payment terms is reflected in the price difference between the respective packages; however, our financing calculation remains internal. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. We recommend proceeding with the 30-day payment term, as it avoids additional financing costs. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
